topic: Event-driven order fulfilment using a transactional outbox, a message broker and three consuming services.
checker_notes: The q8 key says a card-provider timeout is 'retried (1 s, 10 s, 60 s) and then dead-lettered ... and the order keeps its status (PENDING)', which reads as if the message is always dead-lettered; reword it to say it is retried and dead-lettered with on-call paged only if all four attempts fail, in which case the order stays PENDING.

The brief and r8 ask for 'short notes before or after' the diagram, but the reference puts roughly 500 words of prose around it (three long shared-rule bullets plus six failure bullets), so it arguably fails its own format requirement; either trim the notes or move retry and crash handling into diagram Notes or alt blocks, or relax the brief and r8 to 'notes'.

In the reference diagram, the 'Charge' section runs unconditionally after the stock alt block (B->>PAY: StockReserved follows the 'not enough stock' branch), so the short-stock cancellation path is not visually separated from the charge; wrap the Charge section in an 'opt stock reserved' block, or end the not-enough-stock branch with a note, so the diagram itself shows that no charge happens.
